name: Build a Brainrot Defense
desc:
🏰 Welcome to Build a Brainrot Defense!

Place your brainrots, and defend your base from waves of bizarre enemies! 🧟

🛠️ Hatch unique brainrots from the shop!
💥 Face enemies and defend through crazy biomes!
🚀 Earn cash every wave to upgrade your brainrots!
⚡ Unlock rare brainrots of different sizes!

⏰ REMEMBER, your brainrots defend & level up offline! 💤
